class.name: EnvironmentQuery3D
class.brief_description: Filters and scores candidate positions to help 3D AI choose where to move.
class.description: A deterministic, physics-independent first stage of an Environment Query System. Provide candidate positions using [member candidates] or the sampling helpers, then call [method query] or [method query_positions]. Candidates outside [member min_distance] and [member max_distance] are excluded. When [member use_threat] is enabled, candidates closer than [member min_threat_distance] to [member threat_position] are also excluded. Remaining points receive a distance score based on proximity to [member desired_distance] and, optionally, a safety score based on their distance to the threat. Both scores are scaled by [member distance_weight] and [member safety_weight]. Results are sorted by descending score with original input index as a deterministic tiebreaker. [member max_results] can limit the output count. This resource does not perform line-of-sight, physics, occupancy or navigation queries. Validate candidate reachability with [NavigationServer3D] or [PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D] as needed.

method.name: query
method.description: Returns an array of dictionaries with keys [code]position[/code] ([Vector3]), [code]index[/code] ([int]), [code]score[/code] ([float]), [code]distance[/code] ([float]) and [code]threat_distance[/code] ([float]). The threat distance is -1 when threat filtering is disabled. Results are sorted by score, then by original index.

method.name: query_positions
method.description: Returns ranked points without score details.

method.name: sample_ring
method.description: Generates [param count] evenly spaced positions in the XZ plane, starting at [param phase] radians. Counts of 1 to 4096 are supported. The input center remains unchanged.

method.name: sample_grid
method.description: Generates a rectangular grid of candidate points on the XZ plane. [param half_extents] holds the X and Z half widths. The generator rejects invalid inputs or allocations larger than [param max_points] (maximum 65536).

members.member: Points to evaluate; NaN/infinite candidates are ignored.
World-space origin from which distances are measured.
Use XZ distance instead of full 3D distance, useful for ground AI.
Enable filtering and scoring against [member threat_position].
World-space location of a single threat.
Exclude candidates closer to the threat than this inclusive threshold.
Nonnegative weight for threat-distance score when threat filtering is enabled.
Maximum ranked results to return; 0 means unlimited.
